title: A clear example restores proportion
meaning: Directed comparison can give your shared view a proportionate assessment by making the judgement’s foundations clear to both people.
text: A justified assessment becomes more tangible through an understandable example. The Chariot in the physical position of Ajna suggests comparing a shared judgement’s foundations. The Sun in energy supports clarifying meaning through visible material. Justice in emotions feels the assessment’s appropriateness. Your view can distinguish a detail’s actual contribution from an impression that initially occupied all attention, giving different parts of the material their own weight.

For example, you discuss why some instructions seemed useless. One poor drawing stayed with you more strongly than the other pages. Testing a particular task reveals a clear sequence of actions, while the illustration genuinely obscures one part. **A clear foundation helps an assessment fit the material examined.** Your shared view can now distinguish a useful sequence from an unsuccessful illustration. A feeling of fairness belongs to that proportion. You can recognise irritation while still seeing which part of the text it actually describes.

The risk is treating one successful example as justification for every other flaw. A single fragment’s clarity replaces consideration of the whole. Wanting meaning to become visible helps preserve the assessment’s boundary. This sequence has been examined while other parts may still deserve attention. Inquiry keeps its foundation when an understandable example illuminates its own area and leaves room for another well grounded observation.
